svg.title: Yuyuan Han. Teaching robots to read the physics in raw sensor data. PhD student, Xi’an Jiaotong University; visiting PhD student, Politecnico di Milano.
svg.desc: The trace is his portrait as a single-pixel camera would record it: the first 192 of 4,096 two-dimensional Walsh-Hadamard measurements after the DC term, in sequency order, drawn to linear scale; the amber square is the newest sample.
